ns2:section.sectionText: A hands-on exploration of multiple styles of bookbinding. Students will acquire fundamental technical knowledge by creating a variety of book structures using traditional tools and materials. An appreciation of the history of bindings will be gained through readings and virtual visits to Rare Book and Manuscript Rooms. There is a $35.00 class material fee. Graduate student questions may be sent to ischool-advising@illinois.edu
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Information Sciences or Illinois Informatics Institute department.
